summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Partner and Agent Registration flows. Fixed critical bug in agent registration/approval where user document was missing is_active and is_approved fields. All 16 backend tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed.

fixed_during_testing.issue: Agent registration created user document without is_active and is_approved fields, causing 'Account is disabled' error on login
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added is_active: True and is_approved: False to user document creation in register_agent function

fixed_during_testing.issue: Agent approval endpoint only updated agents collection, not users collection, so approved agents still couldn't login
fixed_during_testing.fix: Added db.users.update_one to also update is_approved in users collection when agent is approved

fixed_during_testing.issue: Minor lint warning - ambiguous variable name 'l' in list comprehension

passed_tests: Partner Registration - successful registration with all fields
Agent Registration - successful registration with all fields
Unapproved Partner Login - shows 'Account pending approval' error
Unapproved Agent Login - shows 'Account pending approval' error
Admin View All Users - returns operations, agents, partners
Admin Approve Partner - successfully approves partner
Admin Approve Agent - successfully approves agent
Approved Partner Login - can login after approval
Approved Agent Login - can login after approval
Public File Upload - ID card upload works without auth
Ops User Login - valid credentials accepted
critical_code_review_comments: Agent registration and approval flow now correctly syncs both agents and users collections
Partner registration already had correct implementation - both partners and users collections updated properly
seed_data_creation: Multiple test partners and agents created during testing (testpartner_*, testagent_*, uitest_*, pending_test_*)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner and Agent Registration flows are fully working. Registration creates entries in both role-specific collection (partners/agents) and users collection. Admin approval updates both collections. New users see 'Account pending approval' error until approved by admin. File upload for ID cards works via /api/storage/upload-public endpoint without authentication.

bug_fixed.description: Agent registration and approval flow not syncing users collection
bug_fixed.root_cause: Agent registration created user document without is_active and is_approved fields. Agent approval only updated agents collection, not users collection.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: 1) Added is_active: True, is_approved: False, agent_id to user document in register_agent. 2) Added db.users.update_one in approve_agent to sync is_approved status.
bug_fixed.verification: All 16 backend tests pass, including approved agent login test
